edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as _owner in the Ownable constructor.
transfer forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
allowance for the spender is decremented with SafeMath sub.
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance through _approve.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
balanceOf converts _rOwned through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the raw reflection balance from _rOwned.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned by _getRate.
cooldown[to] is written with block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer branches on block.timestamp to enforce the anti-bot cooldown.
amount parameter drives every check and accounting step in _transfer.
from parameter is used for blacklist and pair checks.
to parameter is used for limit, cooldown and pair checks.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the transaction limit check.
_transfer reads _maxWalletSize for the wallet size check.
_transfer requires both from and to to be non-blacklisted in bots.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to bypass limits and fees.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before performing the automatic swap.
_transfer triggers the router swap while token state is still being updated.
_transfer forwards ETH to the fee wallet mid-transfer.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer for the balance accounting.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains r/t amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard moves the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard burns the fee via _reflectFee.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance in _rOwned.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_getValues fetches the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues applies the _feeAddr1 tax fee numerator.
_getValues applies the _feeAddr2 team fee numerator.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal and can divide by _tTotal.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call with attacker-influenced timing.
swapTokensForEth reads the router from uniswapV2Router.
The Uniswap pair/router callback can re-enter _transfer before balances settle.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
The ETH payout target is the _feeAddrWallet state variable.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the whole contract ETH balance.
openTrading calls the factory createPair external operation.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading computes the initial _maxTxAmount as 15/1000 of supply.
openTrading computes the initial _maxWalletSize as 30/1000 of supply.
manualswap performs an unguarded router swap on the contract balance.
manualswap authorization is a direct comparison with msg.sender.
manualswap requires the caller to equal the _feeAddrWallet address.
manualsend forwards the whole ETH balance to the fee wallet.
manualsend authorization is a direct comparison with msg.sender.
nonosquare writes blacklist entries into the bots mapping.
delBot clears a blacklist entry in the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by the onlyOwner check against _owner.
removeLimits resets _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
removeLimits resets _maxWalletSize to the full supply.
changeMaxTxAmount recomputes _maxTxAmount via mul/div.
changeMaxWalletSize recomputes _maxWalletSize via mul/div.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender() on every protected function.
Local contractTokenBalance is the swap input amount for the router call.
Local currentRate divides the reflection balance into token amounts.
Local contractETHBalance gates whether the ETH payout runs inside _transfer.
tAmount parameter feeds the reflection accounting in _transferStandard.
percentage parameter scales the new _maxTxAmount.
notbot parameter is removed from the blacklist mapping.
bots_ array parameter populates the blacklist mapping.
spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
recipient parameter is the destination of the delegated transfer.
sender parameter is debited in the delegated transferFrom.
percentage parameter scales the new _maxWalletSize.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists inside _transfer and is fully captured by its core transfer logic.
The from parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer blacklist and pair checks.
The to parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer cooldown and limit checks.
The local balance is computed solely to feed the router swap call.
The local rate is the direct output of _getRate used for conversions.
The local ETH balance is only used to decide and fund the fee payout.
tAmount is the only input of the reflection accounting routine.
The percentage parameter is consumed only by the max transaction amount computation.
notbot is used only to clear one entry in the blacklist mapping.
The bots_ array is iterated only to populate the blacklist mapping.
spender is only used as the key of the allowance write.
recipient is only forwarded into the internal transfer routine.
sender is only used as the debited account for the delegated transfer.
The percentage parameter is consumed only by the max wallet size computation.
